# Mandala Codes

> The Universal Language oracle — a reading deck of 64 mandala paintings by
> Adrian Rasmussen. Each card connects a hexagram of the I Ching, a Gene Key,
> and a Human Design gate.

## Learn library

- [Article index (llms.txt)](https://mandalacodes.com/learn/llms.txt): full
  markdown index of all essays and reference articles on mandalas, the
  I Ching, Gene Keys, and Human Design
- [Learn](https://mandalacodes.com/learn/): the human-readable article listing

## The deck

- [The deck index](https://mandalacodes.com/universal-language): all 64 cards
- [The systems](https://mandalacodes.com/the-systems): how the I Ching, Gene
  Keys, and Human Design relate

## Optional

- [The paintings](https://adrianrasmussen.com): the original 64 mandala
  paintings, where they are sold
